type Shape = Circle(Int) | Square(Int) | Dot

fn sign(n: Int) -> Int
  example sign(5) == 1
do
  if n > 0 then
    return 1
  end if
end fn

fn pick(n: Int) -> Int
  example pick(1) == 1
do
  if n > 0 then
    return 1
  else
    let other = 2
  end if
end fn

fn area(s: Shape) -> Int
  example area(Dot) == 0
do
  match s do
    case Circle(r) =>
      return r * r * 3
    case Square(w) =>
      let side = w
    case Dot =>
      return 0
  end match
end fn

fn dead(n: Int) -> Int
  example dead(1) == 1
do
  return n
  let never = 1
end fn
